setup.title: First-time setup
setup.subtitle: 3 steps, a few minutes. Everything is stored on this machine.

license.title: Get started
license.email_hint: One free license per machine and email.
license.key_hint: You get it after subscribing. Move between machines with the same key.
license.beta_desc: Free during the beta, no card needed. It won't be free forever: we'll announce the end at least 10 days ahead, and your license keeps working until the end of that month.
license.trial_desc: No card needed. Unlimited for 3 days from your first question, then 20 free tasks a day.

ai.title: Connect AI
ai.desc: Use your own keys. You pay the AI provider you choose directly; we add nothing on top.
ai.llm_desc: Enter the API URL (if any) and API key, then choose a model
ai.emb_title: Embedding — the model that turns text into vectors
ai.emb_desc: Used to search documents. It is locked to a knowledge base when you create it; changing it later means a new knowledge base.
ai.same_as_llm: Use the same API URL and key as the LLM
ai.rerank_toggle: Add a reranker (optional) — orders search results more precisely
ai.where_note: Enter the URL (if any) and API key, and the models are fetched from the provider for you to choose. You'll find these in the console of the AI provider you choose.
ai.privacy_note: Note: some providers' free keys may use your data to improve their services and are usually rate-limited per minute. Use a paid key for sensitive data or large files.
ai.base_url_hint: Leave empty if your provider only needs an API key
ai.none_found: The provider didn't return a model list — type the model name instead
ai.discover_first: Enter the LLM's API key above first; the models will be listed for you
ai.no_embedding_here: No embedding models on this connection — untick the box below and use another one, or type a name

password.title: Admin password
password.desc: Protects the back office (settings, knowledge, chatbots). The chat page stays open for people you share it with.
password.from_env: The password is already set in this machine's config file.
password.login_note: After this, the back office asks you to sign in.

finish.title: You're ready
finish.desc: Next: create a knowledge base and upload your documents, then create a bot and start asking.

errors.demo_used: This email or machine has already received a free license. Open Settings in the 1n9 app you installed first and copy the key from "License key in use", then enter it here (one license works on one system at a time). Lost it? Contact hello@1n9ai.com.
errors.credential_invalid: The API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check that you copied all of it.
errors.provider_quota_exhausted: The API key is out of quota or credit.
errors.central_unreachable: Can't reach central. Check your internet connection.
errors.tunnel_offline: This machine isn't connected to central yet. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.url_not_allowed: This central can't reach private addresses (localhost or LAN). Use an internet address instead.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.device_replaced: This license was last activated on another machine.
errors.setup_ai_incomplete: Enter an API key and choose a model for both the LLM and the embedding model
errors.setup_discover_no_key: Enter an API key before finding models
errors.provider_auth_failed: The API key is wrong, lacks permission, or doesn't match this URL — check the key and URL
errors.provider_endpoint_not_found: No API found at this URL — check the URL in your provider's docs
errors.provider_http_error: The provider returned an unexpected error — try again or check the provider's status
errors.provider_unreachable: Can't reach the provider — check the URL and your internet connection
errors.task_limit: You've used today's free tasks. Try again after midnight (Thai time), or subscribe for unlimited use with the same key.
errors.login_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: Let your customers talk to the bot in your existing LINE Official Account. No open ports or domain needed.

status.replaced: Another machine is using this license

line.title: LINE Official Account
line.desc: The bot answers text messages in one-to-one chats only. Stickers, images and groups get no reply. Replies are free and unlimited.
line.step1: Open LINE Developers, create a Provider and a Messaging API channel (or use your existing Official Account's).
line.step2: Copy the Channel secret (Basic settings tab) and issue a long-lived Channel access token (Messaging API tab), then paste both below.
line.step3: Click Add channel, copy the Webhook URL into the Messaging API tab, press Verify, then turn on Use webhook.
line.step4: In LINE Official Account Manager, Response settings: turn off Auto-response messages, or they will overlap with the bot.
line.keep: Leave empty to keep the current value
line.confirm_delete: Delete this channel? Customers can't talk to the bot in LINE until you add it again.
line.token_invalid: LINE rejects this channel access token, so the bot can't reply in LINE. Issue a new one in LINE Developers (Messaging API tab → Channel access token) and paste it below.
line.token_unreachable: Couldn't check the token with LINE right now. Try again.
line.welcome: Send a welcome message when someone adds the account
line.not_https: The configured central address is not https://. LINE only delivers webhooks to public https addresses.
line.no_bots: No bots yet. Create one on the Chatbots page first.
line.pc_note: The program must be running and online for the bot to answer. While the machine is off, messages get no reply.

notice.beta_ending: The free beta ends on {date}. After that this license keeps working free for {n} tasks a day, or subscribe for unlimited use with the same key. Your data stays as it is.
notice.beta_ended: The free beta has ended. The license keeps working within the free daily limit; subscribe for unlimited use with the same key. Your data is still here.

alerts.source_held: Live data ‘{name}’ is on hold because the source lost data unexpectedly (e.g. the sheet was cleared or pasted over). The bot still answers from the previous data. Check the source, or open it and confirm if the change was intended.
alerts.source_error: Couldn't fetch live data ‘{name}’. The bot is answering from the last successful fetch. Cause: {detail}
alerts.ai_quota: The LINE bot ‘{name}’ can't answer because your AI key is out of credit or quota. Top up or enable billing with your AI provider (free keys have a small daily quota) and the bot will resume on its own.
alerts.ai_key: The LINE bot ‘{name}’ can't answer because the AI key is invalid or revoked. Go to Settings to enter a new key.
alerts.line_error: The LINE bot ‘{name}’ failed to answer last time: {detail}
alerts.task_limit_missed: The LINE bot ‘{name}’ couldn't answer {count} message(s) today because today's free tasks ran out. Customers were told to try again tomorrow. Subscribe with the same key to answer every message.

tasks.reached: You've used today's free tasks. Answers resume after midnight (Thai time), or subscribe for unlimited use with the same key.
tasks.unlimited: Unlimited use until {date}, then {n} free tasks a day.

displaced.title: This license was most recently activated on another machine
displaced.body: This machine has stopped connecting. One license works on one installation at a time, so another 1n9 program (or another computer) using the same key took it over.
displaced.claim: Use the license on this machine
displaced.confirm: Use the license on this machine? The other installation will be disconnected right away.

line_oa.label: LINE OA ID (optional)
line_oa.hint: Your LINE OA @ID, shown as an add-friend button on the chat page. Leave it empty if LINE is connected under Channels; it is detected for you.
line_oa.hint_detected: Detected from your connected LINE: {ids}. Leave empty to use it, or type another ID.

progress.keep_open: You can close this page, but keep the program running until it finishes. Don't upload again (it bills the AI again).

settings.title: AI connections
settings.description: Add connections and models as options — a KB picks its embedding model when it's created, bots pick their LLM/reranker (none chosen = the default), and the chat mic button uses the default speech-to-text model
settings.step1_desc: Enter a name / URL / API key — works with providers that offer a standard API; the API format is detected from the URL
settings.step2_desc: Pick models from the connections above to keep as options — the one starred ‘Default’ is used when a KB or bot doesn't choose one

secret.will_delete: Will be deleted when you save
secret.keep_blank: Leave empty to keep the current value

conn.name: Name
conn.name_hint: Something easy to remember, e.g. ‘Company AI’ or ‘Office server’
conn.url_help: Find the API URL in your provider's docs — leave it empty if the provider only needs an API key
conn.key_not_needed: API key (not needed for this type)

llm.what: The bot's brain — reads documents and writes the answer

embedding.what: Turns documents into numbers for search — a KB stays tied to the one chosen at creation
embedding.where: Chosen when creating a Knowledge Base

rerank.what: Orders search results more precisely (optional) — needs a connection with a /rerank endpoint
rerank.where: Used by bots with ‘Use rerank’ on

stt.what: Turns speech into text (optional) — an LLM that accepts audio, or a service with an /audio/transcriptions endpoint

model.no_connection: No usable connection yet — add one in the section above first
model.locked_model: Tied to a KB — the model can't be changed
model.locked: Tied to a KB — can't be changed
model.found_n: {n} models found — pick one or type a name
model.dim_hint: Press ‘Test’ and the correct value is filled in
model.dim_ok: Works — this model gives {dim} dimensions (filled in)
model.thinking_used: used {n} thinking tokens (extra time and cost)
model.used_everywhere: Used wherever no specific model is chosen
model.lock_kbs: {n} KB(s) use it — delete those KBs first
model.lock_bots: {n} bot(s) use it — change the model in those bots first
model.need_one: At least one is needed for the system to work

params.title: Extra parameters (advanced)
params.locked: Tied to a KB — can't be edited (some parameters change the vectors)
params.help: Passed straight to the provider and works with any model — see your provider's docs for parameter names · use "headers" / "query" to add HTTP headers or a query string

vector.local_hint: Qdrant on this machine or your LAN — central reaches it through the tunnel the node opens, no ports to open, and the data stays with you
vector.qdrant_hint: A Qdrant that central can reach directly (e.g. Qdrant Cloud)
vector.pgvector_hint: PostgreSQL with pgvector enabled — a cloud service or your own server
vector.pinecone_hint: Pinecone (serverless) — the index is created for you

tunnel.replaced: Another machine is using this license

infra.title: Infrastructure
infra.desc: Set once at install — a wrong value stops the system, so press ‘Edit’ before changing anything
infra.vector_warning: This stores the documents of every KB — a wrong value means bots can't find documents at once. Change it only when moving the database.
infra.central_warning: A wrong value stops both chat and uploads at once — usually set once at install, or when you get a new license
infra.pg_hint: e.g. postgresql://user:password@host:5432/postgres — stored encrypted like other keys
infra.confirm_vector_change:
After changing the database, the {n} existing Knowledge Base(s) won't find their documents (they stay in the old database) and must be uploaded again.

Change it?
infra.vector_subtitle: The database that stores every KB's documents

license_reveal.title: License key in use
license_reveal.failed: Could not read the license key. Sign in again and retry.
license_reveal.note: Keep this key. One license works on one installed system at a time: using it in another 1n9 app moves it there.

skills.uploading: Uploading and reading the formulas... (files not in the standard format are read by AI, which can take a moment)
skills.no_files: No formula files in this skill set yet
skills.err_none_found: No computable formula found in this file — write each formula as an equation (e.g. V = π × (D/2)² × L) and describe its variables
skills.err_not_read: This file hasn't been read yet — press ‘Read formulas again’
skills.err_ai_failed: The AI couldn't read this file: {reason} — fix it, then press ‘Read formulas again’

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to open the back office
login.forgot: Forgot the password? Reset it on the machine that runs this app.
